How much does a bathroom remodel cost?

Gutting the bathroom and starting over — or just refreshing it — what it costs, and what moves the price:

$6,630–$17,530

National average $12,000

Bay Area: $11,599–$28,247 (avg $19,923) — roughly 65% above the national average; labor alone runs $75–$150 an hour here.

Why quotes run $6,600 to $78,500

Scope
A cosmetic refresh — paint, fixtures, hardware — stays near the low end. Moving plumbing or gutting to the studs pushes you toward $30,000+.
The shower
The single most expensive component: about $8,000 installed on average nationally. Curbless and custom tile cost more than a prefab insert.
Plumbing moves
Keeping the toilet, sink, and shower where they are saves thousands. Every relocated drain changes demolition, framing, waterproofing, and tile at once.
Labor
Labor is 40–65% of a bathroom remodel. In San Francisco, expect $75–$150 an hour.
Room size

Two very different projects

Powder room
$1,500–$15,000

Half-bath with a sink and toilet. Smallest footprint, smallest bill — unless you move plumbing.

Primary bathroom
$7,000–$30,000

Full bath with tub or shower, double vanity, more square feet. The room that sets the budget.

Bottom line: the room decides the budget before you pick a single fixture. A powder room refresh and a primary suite gut job aren't the same project.

Common questions

How long does a bathroom remodel take?

A cosmetic refresh takes days. A full gut remodel takes several weeks — longer if plumbing moves or the tile is custom.

What part of a bathroom remodel costs the most?

The shower, then the plumbing. Together they cost more than the toilet, tub, faucets, flooring, and electrical combined.

Do I need a permit to remodel a bathroom?

Usually yes, especially when plumbing or electrical moves. Your contractor should pull it — check with your city's building department first.

Is a bathroom remodel worth it?

Mid-range remodels recoup about 60–65% at resale in San Francisco. Even if you're staying, it's the highest-ROI room after the kitchen.

Every bathroom prices differently.

The range above is a national average. Your price depends on the room's size, the scope, and local labor rates. Take a photo of your bathroom in Brightglow for an estimate on the actual room, and to compare local pros who've done the same work.
